notice.title: Accessible communications
notice.aiSummary: Firms must offer statements and important notices in large print, braille, or screen-reader friendly formats on request at no extra cost. Compliance is required by February 1, 2027.
notice.aiReason: The notice applies to all firms that send statements and notices to retail customers, and Brivanta Bank sends statements and notices for its consumer deposit accounts, loans, mortgages, and card products.

text:
RETAIL CONDUCT AUTHORITY FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Guidance: Accessible communications
Notice number: RCN-2026-018
Issued by: Retail Conduct Authority
Published: 2026-11-03
Effective date: 2027-02-01
1. Who this applies to
All firms that send statements and notices to retail customers.
2. Background
Customers with sight loss or other disabilities must be able to read the information firms send them.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must offer statements and important notices in large print, braille or a screen-reader friendly format on request, at no extra cost.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-02-01.

obligations.text: A firm must offer statements and important notices in large print, braille or a screen-reader friendly format on request, at no extra cost.
obligations.controlDesc: Monthly report of accessible-format requests and their fulfilment times
obligations.reason: Policy POL-ACC-01 states "Statements and important notices are available in large print, braille and screen-reader friendly formats on request, free of charge" which precisely matches all requirements of the obligation, and Control CTL-183's monthly monitoring of accessible-format requests and fulfilment times would detect failures to provide these formats.
